title: Insights launch slice: reduce dashboard cards and tracing pipeline for MVP
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Summary: This ticket documents scope reductions to the Console Insights surface for the initial public MVP. After review with Eng and Design we need to cut a set of non-blocking features to hit the launch date while preserving core value: a single-pane dashboard with per-route latency and cost breakdowns, a lightweight traces tab for sampled requests, and a smallest-viable rollout view.

What we originally intended: multi-card dashboards, long retention tracing, custom dashboard authoring, multi-tenant cost allocation, and percentile heatmaps.

MVP constraints: team capacity and runtime changes require reducing telemetry ingestion work and UI polish. This ticket lists required cuts, acceptance criteria, and rollout guidance.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard: deliver a single Insights page with 3 cards: (a) unit cost per token and cost trend (7d), (b) p50/p95 latency per selected model, (c) error rate + recent error samples. Cards use existing telemetry schema (no new event types). 2) Tracing: provide a Traces view that shows sampled request list (timestamp, route, model, latency, trace-id) and a link to flame-graph placeholder (deferred full flame graph). Retention limited to 7 days for MVP. 3) Cost breakdown: per-route daily delta and top-5 cost drivers for the chosen window. No tag-based allocation or cross-account roll-up for MVP. 4) Rollout controls: integrate A/B/canary toggle in the Rollouts page with a link to Insights (no advanced rollout analytics). 5) All UI components must be behind feature flag 'insights_mvp' and default-off for existing customers. 6) Docs: publish a short runbook + one-pager describing known limitations. 7) Performance: initial page load for Insights must be < 1.2s (from Console CDN) for auth'd users in NA region under staging load tests. 8) Security: no customer PII surfaced in the UI; tracing samples must be scrubbed per trace-scrub policy.
decision_log: 2025-02-18: PM/ENG/Design sync — agreed to cut custom dashboards, long-term retention, and percentile heatmaps. 2025-02-20: Engineering requested to limit tracing retention to 7 days to avoid S3/Coldstore changes for MVP. 2025-02-24: Design proposed simplified card layouts and deferred interactivity to post-MVP. 2025-02-26: Final scope sign-off by Head of Product (Aisha Chen) to proceed with reduced feature set to meet launch window.
notes:
Trade-offs: Cutting custom dashboards reduces immediate flexibility for power users but drastically reduces backend ingestion and index costs. Keeping single-pane cards preserves executive visibility. Tracing retention at 7 days balances storage cost vs debugability; we will add on-demand trace export if needed for incidents.

Follow-ups for post-MVP (create separate tickets): restore custom dashboards, add 90-day trace retention with archive, add tag-based cost allocation, percentile heatmaps, interactive drilldowns and alerts.

Implementation hints for Eng: reuse metrics pipeline 'metrics-v2' and the existing trace sampler; avoid schema changes to events. UI should reuse existing card components from /ui/shared/cards to speed delivery.
